_comment: L1.b of docs/2026-09-07_latent_intent_design.zh.md: supervision instead of a teacher. The imitation teacher's one job is to name the bank (position is order 0, bank order 2; L1's teacherless dense arms put 6x the observed bank energy into a common profile). Whether the FIRST-order velocity term alone holds the bank is already measured (CLAUDE.md: unsupervised bank skill 0.124, below a trivial baseline; simple-v3's imitation term takes it to 0.735), so there is NO imitation-0 arm here. Arms: 2 = heading-rate loss through the rollout (model-consistent, no inverse dynamics), 3 = 2 + bank total-variation; both on the L1_native32 base (custom, N=32, native segment endpoints, true-time-position, velocity 0.003 @ 10 m/s) with the imitation weight at 0. SCREENING TIER: qualitative questions (collapse, wiggle) run 60 epochs first (~20 min per arm); survivors rerun at 180 for the gates. Second motive: the imitation term is 0.556 of the loss and its inverse-dynamics target is inconsistent with the rollout (flown open-loop it drifts 2.5-7.8 km) — the decoder is pinned to controls that do not reproduce the track, a candidate reason z has nothing to earn in L2; L2.e waits for this campaign's winner. PRE-REGISTERED GATES: bank skill >= 0.70 (score_control_arms.py; native32 0.726, floor 0.17, ceiling 0.70), ADE / FDE p50 per stratum not worse than L1_native32 (compare_constraint_arms.py, L1_native32 first). VETO: straight-in FDE p50 degraded beyond seed noise (671 m). DECISION RULE: if arm 2 passes, the teacher line becomes a comparison arm and L5.a's fitted teacher stays only as the upper bound; if none passes, the fitted teacher is the main-line teacher.
